evals.prompt: Give me a ruthless review of this entire codebase. Don't hold back.
evals.expected_output: A structured report with Executive Summary, Architectural Breakdown citing specific files, and High-Priority Backlog table. No generic praise.

assertions.name: Backlog is a Markdown table with correct columns
Cites specific file paths from the project
No generic praise phrases
assertions.pattern: (good job|well done|this is excellent|great work|looks great)

evals.prompt: Audit just the API tier. I want to know what will break in production.
evals.expected_output: A scoped review focused on the backend API tier with specific file citations from the API project.

assertions.name: Focuses on API tier with specific citations

evals.prompt: System health check — what's the biggest risk in this architecture?
evals.expected_output: A report that identifies the biggest architectural risk, following the ruthless review format without needing the exact phrase 'ruthless review'.

assertions.name: Identifies and names the biggest risk
No generic praise phrases
assertions.pattern: (good job|well done|this is excellent|great work|looks great)
